steps.title: Alif, Ba, Ta
steps.body: Meet ا ب ت. Each letter has a shape and a sound.

steps.title: Notice the dots
steps.body: Ba has one dot below. Ta has two dots above.

steps.title: Find Ba
steps.body: Which letter has one dot below?

steps.title: Fathah, kasrah, dammah
steps.body: َ is a short a, ِ is a short i, and ُ is a short u.

steps.title: Let them guide you
steps.body: بَ sounds ba, بِ sounds bi, and بُ sounds bu.

steps.title: Begin with Al-Fatihah
steps.body: Read the first ayah slowly, noticing the spaces between words.

steps.title: A clear declaration
steps.body: Read one ayah of Al-Ikhlas from the canonical Quran reader.

steps.title: Hide selected words
steps.body: Recall the shape of the ayah without rushing.
